title: Physically accurate OpenFOAM case generation for unseen geometries and turbulence-model changes (FoamBench Advanced)

task_sources.name: CFDLLMBench FoamBench Advanced (OpenFOAM v10 revision provided by the authors) and evaluation scripts, BSD-3-Clause

metric.description: Physical success rate over the 13 FoamBench Advanced tasks: the fraction whose submitted OpenFOAM case runs successfully within its time limit and has NMSE < 0.1 against the reference solution. NMSE uses the original CFDLLMBench implementation. Missing or failed cases count as 0; the denominator is 13. Higher is better.

baseline.name: Foam-Agent with gpt-6-luna, max_loop=15, OpenFOAM v10
